cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(lvgl_round_text_contract LANGUAGES C CXX ASM)
if(NOT LVGL_SOURCE)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "LVGL_SOURCE must name the official LVGL 9.5 source")
endif()
if(ROUND_TEXT_ARABIC)
  add_compile_definitions(ROUND_TEXT_ARABIC=1)
endif()
set(LV_BUILD_CONF_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lv_conf.h" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
set(CONFIG_LV_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CONFIG_LV_BUILD_DEMOS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CONFIG_LV_USE_THORVG_INTERNAL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${LVGL_SOURCE}" lvgl)
add_executable(round_text_oracle runtime.cpp)
target_compile_features(round_text_oracle PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_compile_options(round_text_oracle PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -UNDEBUG)
target_compile_definitions(round_text_oracle PRIVATE USE_LVGL_ROUND_TEXT_DEBUG=1)
target_include_directories(round_text_oracle PRIVATE
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/stubs"
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../esphome/components/lvgl_round_text")
target_link_libraries(round_text_oracle PRIVATE lvgl::lvgl m)
